body: This is ugly, I know. Happy to know of an alternative that doesn't add too much complexity for such a small thing.
That just moves the ugliness one line above. :stuck_out_tongue:
You can add `get_dock_container(idx)` method to DockSplitContainer, which automatically casts the child. DockTabContainer has a similar method for getting EditorDock.
Why not reuse the `public` section below?
Seeing this method duplicated multiple times, maybe there should be some helper method to better unify this code. (doesn't need to be in this PR)
If you mean in unison with the `set_main_v/hsplit()` methods, I think there's going to need some internal restructuring on how the docks are stored to achieve that.

The simplest solution would be adding a helper that takes pointer pointer, so you could do
```C++
void set_bottom_hsplit(DockSplitContainer *p_split) { register_split(&bottom_hsplit, p_split); }
```
in the header.
I will look into it once this is merged.
